title: 第26章 你是不是活腻啦
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 路过的人纷纷侧目，脚步放慢，目光黏上来就不肯走。“哎，那不是贫困生温栩栩吗？”“对对对，就是她。怎么站这儿？大包小包的……”“应该是被陈静赶出来的。陈静搬她宿舍去了。”“陈静？那个换了三个宿舍的陈静？”“除了她还有谁。上学期把一姑娘逼得抑郁症那个。”“啧，那温栩栩惨了。陈静那种人，谁能跟她住一块儿？”有人叹了口气，语气里带着点同情：“站这儿半天了，今晚住哪儿啊？不会要流落街头吧？”话音刚落，旁边一个女生翻了个白眼：“同情她干嘛？苍蝇不叮无缝的蛋，陈静怎么不欺负别人专欺负她？”“就是！”另一个女生附和道，“我听说她这些天夜不归宿，傍上什么金主了。被赶出来也是活该。”“真的假的？”“真的！她们宿舍人说的，连续好几天没回来，一回来就闹成这样。”“啧啧啧……看着挺老实一人，没想到啊。”“老实什么呀，你看她怀里抱那破罐子，咸菜罐吧？被赶出来还要把咸菜带走，穷酸死了。”“哈哈哈哈说不定是金主送的定情信物呢？”“你可闭嘴吧，金主送咸菜罐？那是什么穷鬼金主。”笑声一片。议论声越来越大，目光越来越刺眼。有人从她身边走过，故意放慢脚步，上下打量一眼，然后跟同伴交换一个意味深长的眼神。有人直接掏出手机，对着她拍了张照，也不知道要发哪去。温栩栩站在原地，听着那些话一句一句飘进耳朵里。面无表情。她把怀里的宋代建窑黑釉油滴茶罐抱得更紧了一点，生怕这宝贝玩意儿磕着碰着。她在心里默默数着：一百二十万、七十万代言、彩票剩下的二十多万……加起来两百多万。等把这罐子卖了，她能把自已埋进RM币里。随便你们笑。温栩栩低着头，嘴角微微动了动。突然——一阵低沉的引擎声从远处传来。不是普通轿车那种闷响，是那种一听就很贵的、带着压迫感的轰鸣。人群下意识往两边让开。黑色迈凯伦的引擎声低沉浑厚，像一头优雅的野兽缓缓靠近。还没等车停稳，不少女生的目光就跟被胶水粘住一样，死死钉在那辆车上。“卧槽卧槽卧槽！迈凯伦P1？！”“什么P1，那是Senna！限量版！落地小一千万！”“一千万？？？我一辈子都挣不到个零头……”“你懂什么，这车全球限量，有钱都不一定买得到。京H·S8888，光这牌子就够买一套房了。”“等等……这车我认识！是司凛的！”“校草？那个艺术管理系的司凛？”“废话，全校开这车的就他一个。上周不是说出车祸了吗？这就出院了？”“这恢复速度也太快了吧……”“有钱人呗，住最好的医院，用最好的医生，恢复能不快吗？”有人压低声音，语气里带着掩不住的八卦：“他把车开到女生宿舍楼下干嘛？该不会是来接人的吧？”“卧槽……司凛有女朋友了？没听说过啊！”“他那种人，豪门千金都懒得看一眼，怎么可能有女朋友？”“就是，听说他出了名的不近女色。上次表演系的系花堵他表白，他直接绕道走了。”“那他现在来这儿干嘛？总不能是来视察宿舍环境的吧？”“等等等等，他车停下来了——”所有人的目光齐刷刷追着那辆惹眼的迈凯伦。车缓缓减速，打着右转向灯，不偏不倚——直接停在温栩栩面前。全场都安静了。只见那辆迈凯伦的蝴蝶门缓缓向上掀开。司凛从车上下来，额头上还贴着一小块纱布，但丝毫不影响颜值。他眉眼深邃，鼻梁高挺，眼角微微上挑，带着一种天生的傲气。左耳的钻石耳钉在夕阳下闪了一下，张扬又不羁，整个人往那儿一站，就跟杂志封面走下来似的。司凛下车后，第一眼看到的是一堆横七竖八的行李。然后目光往上移，落在抱着破罐子的温栩栩身上。他顿了一下。那天揪着自已要别墅的女孩，肤色好像没有这么白？难道是自已撞出幻觉了？司凛微微眯起眼，视线在温栩栩脸上停留了两秒。然后对上了温栩栩那双亮晶晶的眼睛。那双眼睛里，此刻正燃烧着一种熟悉的、炙热的、毫不掩饰的光芒——那光芒他见过，就在自已昏迷前最后一眼。那是对别墅的渴望，对金钱的向往，对“你撞了我家牛棚必须赔我一套房”的坚定信念。司凛收回目光。嗯，确认过眼神，没认错。就是那个自已昏迷前死死抓着自已要别墅的财迷。司凛绕过车头，轻轻松松把温栩栩的行李放到车上。随即，他从兜里掏出一张卡，随手抛给温栩栩。“别墅门禁卡。今晚就能住。”温栩栩手忙脚乱接住，低头看了一眼。磨砂黑的卡面，沉甸甸的质感，上面烫金的“青林湾”三个字在夕阳下闪着低调的光。门禁卡。别墅的门禁卡！！！她的眼睛“噌”地一下亮了，比看见亲人还亲。温栩栩攥紧那张卡，抬头看向司凛，眼神里写满了真诚的崇拜：“不愧是校草，抛卡的姿势都那么帅！”司凛：“……”旁边围观的众人：“！！！”“我、我没看错吧？司凛在帮温栩栩搬行李？？”“那个不近女色、生人勿近的司凛？？”“他刚才是不是从兜里掏了张卡给她？别墅门禁卡！！”“温栩栩不是刚被赶出宿舍吗？怎么转眼就住上别墅了？？”众人直接炸锅了。刚才说“苍蝇不叮无缝的蛋”那个女生，此刻脸上的表情精彩得像打翻了调色盘。刚才笑她“咸菜罐”的那个，手里的奶茶已经彻底捏扁了。司凛见温栩栩还抱着那个灰扑扑的黑罐子不撒手。“这什么？”他随口问，“我帮你拿着吧。”温栩栩下意识把罐子往怀里一缩，抱得更紧了。“不用不用，我自已抱！”“这个是宋代建窑黑釉油滴茶罐。我正准备找买家出手呢。”司凛听到“建窑”两个字，脚步微微顿了一下。旁边还没散开的人群听到这话，直接笑出声。“哈哈哈哈她说什么？宋代建窑？”“就那破咸菜罐子？笑死我了。”“刚从垃圾堆里捡的吧？还宋代呢。”“她还真敢说啊？宋代建窑？那破罐子能是真的？”“就是，骗人也不看看对象，司凛家可是收藏世家，他爷爷在圈内都是数得上号的。”话音刚落，宿舍楼门口忽然传来一声尖锐的怒吼：“温栩栩！！！你给我站住！！！”众人回头，只见陈静披头散发地从楼里冲出来，手里还拎着那个封着口的奶茶杯，脸都气绿了。“你是不是活腻了了？！”她举着杯子冲到温栩栩面前，“把这种脏东西放我床头？！你怎么敢的？！”
content_en: People passing by looked sideways, slowed down their steps, and refused to leave with their eyes glued to her."Hey, isn't that Wen Xuxu, a poor student?" "That's right, that's her. Why are you standing here? With all the big and small bags..." "She should have been kicked out by Chen Jing. Chen Jing moved to her dormitory." "Chen Jing? The Chen Jing who changed dormitories three times?" "Who else is there besides her? The one who drove a girl into depression last semester.""Tsk, that's so miserable for Wen Xuxu. Who can live with her?"Someone sighed with a hint of sympathy in his voice: "You've been standing here for a long time, where are you going to live on the street?"As soon as he finished speaking, a girl next to her rolled her eyes: "Why don't you pity her?"Why don't you just bully others?" "That's right!" another girl echoed, "I heard that she has been staying with some kind of sponsor.She deserves to be kicked out." "Really?" "The people in their dormitory said that they didn't come back for several days, and they made such a fuss when they came back."She's quite an honest person, I didn't expect that." "Honestly, look at that broken jar in her arms.She was forced to take away the pickles.Hahaha, maybe it was a token of love from the sponsor?" "Shut up, what kind of pickle jar is that from the sponsor?"The chatter became louder and louder, and the gazes became more and more dazzling.Someone walked past her, deliberately slowed down, looked up and down, and then exchanged a meaningful look with his companion.Someone took out his cell phone and took a picture of her without knowing where to send it.Wen Xuxu stood there, listening to the words floating into his ears one by one.Expressionless.She hugged the black-glazed oil-dropped tea jar from the Song Dynasty kiln in her arms a little tighter, for fear of bumping this precious thing.She counted silently in her mind: 1.2 million, 700,000 endorsements, the remaining 200,000 from the lottery... totaling more than 2 million.After selling this jar, she can bury herself in RM coins.Laugh all you want.Wen Xuxu lowered his head and moved the corners of his mouth slightly.Suddenly - a low engine sound came from the distance.It's not the muffled sound of an ordinary car, but the kind of oppressive roar that sounds expensive at first sight.The crowd subconsciously moved aside.The engine sound of the black McLaren is deep and deep, approaching slowly like an elegant beast.Before the car stopped, many girls' eyes were fixed on the car as if they were glued."Holy shit, shit, shit! McLaren P1?!" "What P1, that's Senna! Limited edition! 10 million less!" "Ten million??? I can't make even a fraction in my life..." "What do you know? This car is limited to the world, and even if you have money, you may not be able to buy it. Beijing H·S8888, this brand alone is enoughI bought a house." "Wait a minute... I know this car!It belongs to the school boy?" "Nonsense, he was the only one in the school who drove this car.Didn't he recover so quickly..."Good doctor, can you recover quickly?" Someone lowered his voice and said with a hint of gossip, "Why did he drive the car downstairs to the girls' dormitory?Isn't he here to pick someone up?" "Damn it... Si Lin has a girlfriend?" "How can a rich man like him have a girlfriend?"Friends?""I heard that he is not known for being a womanizer. The last time the actress from the acting department blocked him, he took a detour.""Then why is he here to inspect the dormitory environment?""Wait a minute, his car stopped-" Everyone's eyes were chasing the eye-catching McLaren.The car slowed down slowly, turned on the right turn signal, and stopped directly in front of Wen Xuxu.The whole place fell silent.I saw the McLaren's butterfly door slowly opening upwards.Si Lin got out of the car with a small piece of gauze on his forehead, but it did not affect his appearance at all.He has deep eyebrows, a high bridge of nose, and slightly raised corners of his eyes, with a kind of natural arrogance.The diamond earrings on her left ear flashed in the setting sun, showing off and uninhibited. When she stood there, she looked like she was stepping off the cover of a magazine.After Si Lin got out of the car, the first thing he saw was a pile of luggage.Then his eyes moved upward and landed on Wen Xuxu, who was holding a broken jar.He paused.The girl who grabbed him for the villa that day didn't seem to have such a fair complexion?Could it be that he was hallucinating?Si Lin narrowed his eyes slightly and stayed on Wen Xuxu's face for two seconds.Then he met Wen Xuxu's shining eyes.Those eyes were burning with a familiar, hot, and unabashed light at this moment - he had seen that light before he fell into coma for the last time.It was the desire for a villa, the yearning for money, and the firm belief that "if you hit my bullpen, you must pay me a house."Si Lin withdrew his gaze.Well, I checked with my eyes and saw that I was right.He was the money-lover who clung to him for a villa before he fell into coma.Si Lin walked around the front of the car and easily put Wen Xuxu's luggage on the car.Immediately, he took out a card from his pocket and threw it to Wen Xuxu."Villa access card. You can stay here tonight." Wen Xuxu caught it hurriedly and looked down.The card surface is matte black and has a heavy texture. The three words "Qinglin Bay" gilded on it shine low-key in the sunset.Access card.Villa access card!!!Her eyes suddenly lit up, and she felt closer than seeing her relatives.Wen Xuxu clutched the card tightly and looked up at Si Lin, her eyes full of sincere admiration: "As expected of the school boy, the way he throws the card is so handsome!" Si Lin: "..." The people watching next to him: "!!!" "I, I read that right, right? Si Lin is helping Wen Xuxu move the card."Luggage?""That Si Lin who doesn't like women?""Did he just give her a card?""Didn't Wen Xuxu just get kicked out of the villa?"Everyone was shocked.The girl who just said, "Flies don't bite seamless eggs," had an expression on her face that was so wonderful that it looked like she had knocked over a palette.The one who just laughed at her "pickle jar" had completely crushed the milk tea in his hand.Si Lin saw that Wen Xuxu was still holding the dusty black jar and wouldn't let go."What is this?" he asked casually, "Let me hold it for you." Wen Xuxu subconsciously shrank the jar into her arms and hugged her tighter."No, no, I'll take it myself!" "This is a black-glazed oil-dropped tea jar from Jian Kiln in the Song Dynasty. I'm about to find a buyer for it." Si Lin paused slightly when he heard the word "Jian Kiln".The crowd nearby who had not dispersed laughed out loud when they heard this."Hahahahaha what did she say? A kiln was built in the Song Dynasty?" "Just that broken pickle jar? You laughed me to death." "You just picked it up from the garbage dump? It's from the Song Dynasty." "She really dares to say that? A kiln was built in the Song Dynasty? Can that broken jar be real?" "Even if you lie to people, you don't even know who they are. The Si Lin family is a family of collectors.His grandfather is one of the best in the industry." As soon as he finished speaking, a sharp roar came from the door of the dormitory building: "Wen Xuxu!Stop!" Everyone turned around and saw Chen Jing rushing out of the building with the sealed milk tea cup in her hand."Are you tired of living?!" She rushed to Wen Xuxu holding a cup, "Put this dirty thing on my bedside?! How dare you?!"
